text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s u-s-i-n-g s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t s-o-f-t-w-a-r-e, f-i-l-l-i-n-g c-l-u-t-c-h d-a-t-e-s a-n-d h-a-s-h r-a-t-i-o-s t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e r-e-a-r-s
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-y-n-t-h-e-s-i-z-e-d o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l p-e-r-m-i-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-i-t-h e-d-i-t-a-b-l-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, a-d-d-i-n-g f-a-k-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e-s a-n-d s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-u-s o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p c-h-a-i-n v-i-a l-e-t-t-e-r-h-e-a-d p-d-f-s s-h-o-w-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s b-e-t-w-e-e-n i-n-v-e-n-t-e-d s-e-l-l-e-r-s o-v-e-r y-e-a-r-s
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-i-m-a-l-s a-s "c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d," i-n-c-l-u-d-i-n-g s-t-o-c-k p-h-o-t-o-s a-n-d f-a-k-e h-e-a-l-t-h c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g t-o b-u-y-e-r-s w-i-t-h-i-n t-h-e c-o-u-n-t-r-y, p-a-c-k-i-n-g s-e-c-r-e-t-l-y t-o a-v-o-i-d c-u-s-t-o-m-s i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n
